summary: Forum Energy Technologies filed an 8-K solely to disclose the issuance of a legal opinion from Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher LLP in connection with a prospectus supplement dated August 28, 2026, under an existing S-3 registration statement. The supplement relates to a selling stockholder's offering of up to 237,552 shares of common stock. No terms, pricing, or special-situation mechanics are provided. The filing is a routine administrative matter supporting a shelf takedown, not an independent special situation. What to watch: the offering's pricing and any subsequent capital return or restructuring announcements.
